title: Quick-fix Flaky Ukrainian Herbal Wrap
description: A delicious and easy Ukrainian dish featuring flaky pastry, caramelized sugar sauce, and infused oil, all wrapped in a ti-leaf wrap.
instructions: Roll out the ti-leaf wraps to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, cold butter, and sugar, and use a pastry blender to work the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the water, eggs, dill weed, and parsley to the bowl, and mix until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead it a few times until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces, and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the tops of the dough circles with olive oil.
Place a tablespoon of sugar on each dough circle, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough in half over the sugar, and press the edges together to seal the wrap.
Brush the tops of the wraps with the infusion oil, if using.
Place the wraps on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the wraps warm, or at room temperature.
